tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground everywhere (`.site`, header, footer, dark cards). Also the ink on coral and violet fills (buttons, accent bands, role tags).

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: Floating panels: megamenu, mobile menu, search overlay.

tokens.name: bg-inset
tokens.usage: Recessed fills: callouts, blockquotes, code, nav-item hover, photo placeholders, intro-box list cells.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Default 1px hairline between sections, rows, grid cells (the 1px-gap-over-rule grid trick) and the header bar dividers.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Stronger 1px border on chips, the mobile Menu toggle, tier cards and donate quick links. 1.6:1 on `bg`: these controls are always labelled, so the border is not the only cue; do not use it as the sole affordance.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Headings, nav, link rows, primary copy on `bg`, `bg-raised`, `bg-inset` (16.7:1 on `bg`).

tokens.name: text-2
tokens.usage: Body prose (`.prose`, `.doc`), callout copy, card bios (12.5:1 on `bg`).

tokens.name: text-3
tokens.usage: Secondary copy: hero asides, strip-card bodies, sidebar links at rest, event locations (9.6:1 on `bg`).

tokens.name: text-4
tokens.usage: Quietest text: footer, TOC labels, board meta rows, roman/letter clause numbers (6.7:1 on `bg`).

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: Primary accent: Donate, `.btn--coral`, CTA bands, active nav underline, hover state for every link, inline links in prose, focus ring (2px). As text it reads 6.6:1 on `bg`; on a coral fill set text in `bg`. sRGB fallback in the source: #ff6a43.

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: Secondary accent: mono kickers and breadcrumbs, list numbers, the 3px left bar on callouts/quotes/code, row-list arrows, Silver tier underline, `--violet` bands and strip cards (ink `bg`, 6.9:1). Never set coral on violet (1.0:1). sRGB fallback in the source: #b085ff.

tokens.name: violet-ink
tokens.usage: Violet for light grounds only: links and numbers inside `band-bg` sections and the light tier card (5.9:1 on `band-bg`). sRGB fallback in the source: #703dc6.

tokens.name: band-bg
tokens.usage: Light band ground: the home sponsors band, the grant Application box, “How your donation helps”, the Diamond tier card, and the onion disc behind the header logo.

tokens.name: band-text
tokens.usage: Ink on `band-bg` (16.7:1); also the 2px top rule above logo rows and form titles in light bands.

tokens.name: band-rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines and 1px-gap grid on `band-bg` (Application field grid).

tokens.name: text-lede
tokens.usage: Lede paragraphs after the first `.doc` heading, the fund lede and legal-index intro (14.3:1 on `bg`). Hard-coded in custom.css; not yet a `:root` token.

tokens.name: text-year-past
tokens.usage: Past-year numerals on the Events page, set at 40px+ only (3.5:1 on `bg`: passes for large text, fails for body). Hard-coded in custom.css.

tokens.name: rule-quiet
tokens.usage: Definition-row hairlines in legal documents. Hard-coded in custom.css.

tokens.name: band-field
tokens.usage: Field cells inside the light Application band. Hard-coded in custom.css.

tokens.name: band-text-2
tokens.usage: Muted copy on `band-bg`: field hints, “How your donation helps” subtitle (8.2:1). Hard-coded in custom.css.

tokens.name: band-text-3
tokens.usage: Mono form notes on `band-bg` (9.9:1). Hard-coded in custom.css.

tokens.name: logo-tile
tokens.usage: White tile behind sponsor and partner logos designed for light grounds. Hard-coded (`#fff`) in custom.css.

styles.name: display-short
styles.usage: One-word page titles (`.display-h1--short`). Fluid: clamp(56px, 13cqi, 168px). Always uppercase, font-stretch 118%.

styles.name: display-h1
styles.usage: Page hero H1 (`.display-h1`). Fluid: clamp(32px, 7.6cqi, 104px). Uppercase, font-stretch 118%, text-wrap balance.

styles.name: home-title
styles.usage: Home hero title. Fluid: clamp(40px, 7.4cqi, 94px). Uppercase, stretch 118%.

styles.name: section-h2
styles.usage: Section and band headings (`.section-h2`, band titles). Fluid: clamp(32px, 4.4cqi, 56px). Uppercase, stretch 118%.

styles.name: tier-price
styles.usage: Sponsor-tier price figures. Fluid: clamp(40px, 4.6cqi, 56px). Stretch 118%.

styles.name: prose-h2
styles.usage: H2 in rendered Markdown (`.prose`, `.doc` at 36px). Fluid from 26px. Uppercase, stretch 112–118%, with a `rule` top border.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Strip-card and donate-section titles. Uppercase, stretch 112%.

styles.name: prose-h3
styles.usage: H3 in prose, legal headings, event titles. Fluid from 20px. Uppercase, stretch 112%.

styles.name: card-name
styles.usage: Board member names, donate card headings. Uppercase, stretch 112%.

styles.name: h4
styles.usage: H4 and in-kind sponsor names; uppercase inside `.doc`.

styles.name: lede
styles.usage: Hero lede (`.lede`). Fluid: clamp(18px, 2cqi, 24px). `text` colour, text-wrap pretty.

styles.name: lede-doc
styles.usage: First paragraph under a `.doc` H2 and the fund lede, in `text-lede`.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Body copy in `.prose`, `.doc`, `.legal-doc` (legal: line-height 1.7), in `text-2`.
styles.sample: The Perl and Raku Foundation funds the people who keep the languages running.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Card bodies, definition rows, strip-card copy.

styles.name: nav-link
styles.usage: Megamenu links, sidebar and TOC links.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: `.btn` labels: uppercase, stretch 112%. Donate CTA 17px, header Donate 16px.

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: Header nav items (`/about`, `/grants`), link chips, legal notices.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Kickers and breadcrumbs above display headings, in `violet`.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Megamenu and sidebar labels, numbers (01, 02), figcaptions, footer legal, role tags (weight 600).

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Board card meta rows, in `text-4`.

tokens.name: space-touch
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target: mobile header actions, chips, toggles, mobile menu links.

tokens.name: space-btn
tokens.usage: `.btn` min-height.

tokens.name: space-cta
tokens.usage: Donate CTA min-height; `.row-list` row min-height.

tokens.name: space-card
tokens.usage: Board card body, gi-tile and callout inline padding (callout 20px 24px).

tokens.name: space-cell
tokens.usage: Fund intro-box cells, megamenu column padding (28px 32px 32px).

tokens.name: space-header-x
tokens.usage: Header brand and Donate horizontal padding; desktop TOC padding.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything: buttons, cards, chips, bands, tiles. The system is square.

tokens.name: radius-search
tokens.usage: Only inside the themed Pagefind search UI.

tokens.name: radius-disc
tokens.usage: The `band-bg` disc behind the onion logo in the header.

layout.note: Fluid layout variables from `:root`; `cqi` is relative to the `.site` container (container-type: inline-size).

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Horizontal page padding for every full-width section, band and footer.

tokens.name: section-pad
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of sections, CTA bands and the sidebar.

stroke.note: Border widths used throughout; the design separates with rules, never shadows or rounded cards.

tokens.name: stroke-rule
tokens.usage: Every hairline: section borders, row lists, grid gaps.

tokens.name: stroke-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring (`coral`, 2px offset), sidebar/TOC left bars, light-band top rules.

tokens.name: stroke-accent
tokens.usage: `violet` left bar on callouts, quotes, code; active nav underline (inset, `coral`); intro-box cell top bar.

tokens.name: stroke-tier
tokens.usage: Inset bottom bar on Gold (`coral`) and Silver (`violet`) sponsor logo tiles.

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: Megamenu panel only.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Search overlay panel only.
